# kakobuy spreadsheet

> Independent KakoBuy qualityreps spreadsheet. 4,000+ replica finds with warehouse QC photos. Not affiliated with KakoBuy.com. Started in 2024.

The list is free to browse. Affiliate links to kakobuy.com may earn a commission. Most items are replicas, not authentic branded goods. Customs into the EU is not guaranteed.

## Main

- [Home](https://kakobuyqcspreadsheet.com/): English homepage and latest finds
- [Polska](https://kakobuyqcspreadsheet.com/pl.html): Polish homepage
- [Deutschland](https://kakobuyqcspreadsheet.com/de.html): German homepage
- [Full spreadsheet](https://kakobuyqcspreadsheet.com/spreadsheet.html): All 4,000+ finds
- [QC photos](https://kakobuyqcspreadsheet.com/qc.html): Warehouse QC gallery
- [Coupons](https://kakobuyqcspreadsheet.com/coupons.html): Working codes including FINDS20
- [FAQ](https://kakobuyqcspreadsheet.com/faq.html): English, Polish, German answers
